deadline.value: Apply by January 31, 2027 for Fall admission and funding consideration.

gre_general.value: GRE scores are optional; if you send one, use BGSU institution code 1069.
gre_general.quote: if you choose to submit a GRE score, send it to BGSU using Institution Code: 1069

supervisor.value: The fetched pages state no supervisor-agreement rule for admission.

funding.value: About 20 new teaching assistantships are awarded each year on a competitive basis.
funding.quote: There are about 20 new openings annually awarded on a competitive basis.

entry_route.value: Admission requires a master's degree in mathematics or statistics; related master's degrees may be admitted.
entry_route.quote: A master’s degree in mathematics or statistics from an accredited institution with a minimum GPA of 3.2

notes: Mathematics and Statistics share one application page.
